第 47 章 Introduce an Engineering Ladder引入工程职级体系

Lisa van Gelder / 丽莎·范·盖尔德

— 第 139 页 —

You know you want to implement an engineering ladder at your company. What's next? If you just tell your engineers that you have defined a ladder and it now applies to them, you might find that they revolt! As vice president of engineering, I've introduced an engineering ladder at two companies: Stride Consulting and Bauer Xcel. Here, I present the seven steps that I've gone through to ensure it has been successfully adopted.

你知道你想在公司实施工程职级体系。接下来呢？如果你只是告诉工程师你定义了一个职级体系、现在适用于他们，你可能会发现他们造反！作为工程 VP，我在两家公司引入过工程职级体系：Stride Consulting 和 Bauer Xcel。这里我介绍我经历的七个步骤以确保它被成功采纳。

1. Communicate the Why1. 沟通为什么

You want your team to feel the ladder is for them. If your company has never had an engineering ladder, you need to be very clear about why you think now is the right time to introduce one and what problems you think it will solve. Explain how they will benefit.

你想让团队觉得职级体系是为他们服务的。如果你的公司从未有过工程职级体系，你需要非常清楚为什么你认为现在是引入它的合适时机、你认为它会解决什么问题。解释他们会怎么受益。

2. Get Your Team to Define the Levels Themselves2. 让你的团队自己定义层级

You want your team to feel that the ladder is for them rather than imposed on them. The best way to do that is to task the team to define the ladder itself. I start by taking Rent the Runway's engineering ladder and adapting it to the organization. Then, I share it with the entire engineering team, along with some other example ladders (Kickstarter, Meetup, Intent Media, etc.) and make the ladder editable by the entire company. Everyone gets a chance to add comments and define levels—including their own level—before the ladder goes into effect.

你想让团队觉得职级体系是为他们服务的而不是强加的。最好的方式是让团队自己定义。我从 Rent the Runway 的工程职级体系开始，根据组织调整。然后我把它和其他示例职级体系（Kickstarter、Meetup、Intent Media 等）一起分享给整个工程团队，并让全公司都可编辑。每个人都有机会加评论、定义层级——包括他们自己的层级——在职级体系生效前。

At Stride, I had a series of meetings with the seniors during which we went through each level, skill by skill, and agreed on definitions. At Bauer Xcel, I put stories into the sprint for every team to make sure people had time marked out when they could review the ladder and comment. Then, we created a Slack channel for people to discuss wording they disagreed with and come to a consensus.

在 Stride，我和高级工程师开了一系列会议，逐层级、逐技能过，就定义达成一致。在 Bauer Xcel，我给每个团队的 sprint 加了故事，确保人们有时间标记什么时候可以审查职级体系并评论。然后我们创建了一个 Slack 频道让人们讨论不同意的措辞并达成共识。

— 第 140 页 —

3. Communicate the How—How Will It Be Implemented?3. 沟通怎么做——怎么实施？

The team needs to understand what is going to happen once you put this ladder in place.

团队需要理解一旦你把这个职级体系落地后会发生什么。

  • What happens if people aren't acting at their current level? Are they demoted? Is there a grace period?如果人们没按当前层级表现会怎样？会被降级吗？有宽限期吗？
  • What happens if a role people are performing is redefined? What happens if they feel they can no longer perform that role?如果人们正在做的角色被重新定义会怎样？如果他们觉得自己不能再做那个角色会怎样？
  • What happens if people are acting at the next level up? Are they promoted? How much of the next level must people do before they are promoted?如果人们在下一层级表现会怎样？会被晋升吗？人们需要做到下一层级的多少才会被晋升？
  • How is salary affected?工资怎么受影响？
  • How will this tie into the performance review/promotion process?这怎么和绩效评估/晋升流程挂钩？

You'll want to think through all of the implications before introducing the ladder to your team. At Bauer Xcel, we sent out an anonymous survey asking about team preferences for how to handle level setting.

在向团队介绍职级体系前，你要想清楚所有影响。在 Bauer Xcel，我们发了一个匿名调查问团队偏好怎么处理层级设定。

4. Try It Out!4. 试用！

Use your new engineering ladder in the performance review process and give folks the chance to discuss where they are on the ladder. I wouldn't use it for a formal performance review before people have had time to kick the tires a little, so I'd suggest doing a trial run on volunteers before using it for real. How long does this take? In my experience it takes at least a quarter to roll out an engineering ladder. It takes time to go through the initial comments and create the levels, and then if you do a trial run as part of the standard performance review process, you might need to wait until the next performance review starts (at Stride, they were every six months). That's fine, it gives your engineers more time to get used to the idea. Hopefully, your volunteers are enthusiastic about how much the ladder helped them so that others are excited to use it next time!

在绩效评估流程中使用你的新工程职级体系，给大家机会讨论他们在职级体系中的位置。在人们有时间试一下之前我不会把它用于正式绩效评估，所以我建议在正式使用前先在志愿者身上试运行。这需要多久？根据我的经验，推出工程职级体系至少需要一个季度。过最初评论和创建层级需要时间，然后如果你作为标准绩效评估流程的一部分做试运行，你可能需要等下次绩效评估开始（在 Stride 是每六个月一次）。这没关系，这给你的工程师更多时间适应这个想法。希望你的志愿者对职级体系帮了他们多少感到热情，这样其他人下次会兴奋地使用它！

— 第 141 页 —

5. Review5. 回顾

Gather feedback from your volunteers. Were some areas unclear? Were some skills missing from different roles? Give people a chance to adapt the ladder based on the review they just did. Open a final review round from the rest of your engineers, too.

收集志愿者的反馈。有些地方不清楚吗？不同角色缺了某些技能吗？给人们机会根据刚做的评估调整职级体系。也向其他工程师开最后一轮评审。

6. Use for Real6. 正式使用

Build the engineering ladder into the performance review process. After receiving feedback, engineers discuss where they are on the ladder with their manager and what they need to work on to get to the next level.

把工程职级体系建入绩效评估流程。收到反馈后，工程师和经理讨论他们在职级体系中的位置、以及需要努力什么才能到下一层级。

7. Make It a Living, Breathing Document7. 让它成为活的文档

Skills and roles are constantly changing, and the ladder needs to adapt with them. I allow the ladder to be edited by the entire company before every performance review cycle, lock it during the cycle, and then allow editing again afterward.

技能和角色在不断变化，职级体系需要随之适应。我允许全公司在每个绩效评估周期前编辑职级体系，周期中锁定，之后再允许编辑。
